traits.desc: Can have up to three gut lassos at a time. Each gut lasso can be attacked (AC 13; 5 hp; immunity to poison). Destroying a lasso deals no damage to the offal walker which can extrude a replacement gut lasso on its next turn. A gut lasso can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a DC 13 Str check vs. it.
